arguments.command:
python3 -c '
import re
path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
with open(path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    xml = f.read()
parts = xml.split("</w:p>")
modified = 0
for i, part in enumerate(parts):
    texts = re.findall(r"<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>", part, re.S)
    full = "".join(texts).strip()
    if full and full.isupper():
        new_part = part.replace("<w:rPr>", "<w:rPr><w:u w:val=\"single\"/>")
        if new_part != part:
            parts[i] = new_part
            modified += 1
xml = "</w:p>".join(parts)
with open(path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write(xml)
print("Headlines underlined:", modified)
'
